name: Wall of Flesh [Selfless, Teamwork]
body:
You swarm with your allies, becoming a wall of creatures.

Prerequisite(s): Small size or smaller.

Benefit(s): Adjacent allies are considered one size category larger for determining CMD and the way combat maneuvers and abilities affect them.
